title: 安全带上的小搭子，选哪只？｜16秒UGC双款对比

shots.line: 就这两个安全带小搭子，我选不出来了！
shots.action: Use image 1 as the approved starting composition. Image 2 locks the left white-hat SKU; image 3 locks the right headphones-and-denim SKU. The left hand holds the white-hat product, while the right product remains on the unoccupied hanging belt beside the door. A stable close-up with one very subtle camera push-in; keep both complete assemblies visible and stationary. Do not install, pull, fasten, detach, or exchange either product. Finish the spoken hook within the first three seconds and hold the final pose for the remaining second.
